meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 uv 运行 Python(必带 numpy,绝不用 pandas,使用 DuckDB/Polars/pyarrow),按操作类型自动选工具,直接查文件、做聚合/过滤/排序/关联,输出结果并报告处理时间和行数;需要绘图时用 matplotlib。
howto.when: 当你说出“analyze the data”等分析类关键词,或要求分析 CSV/Parquet 等数据文件、做分组/过滤/关联等操作,或提出时间趋势/相关性/SQL 查询等需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我看一下这个 CSV 文件,按类别汇总销售额。
say.note: 会用 DuckDB 直接查询并返回汇总表。

say.text: 把这份 parquet 按金额大于 100 过滤,再按日期排序。
say.note: 会用 Polars 惰性计算完成过滤和排序。

say.text: 对比昨天和今天的数据,看看变化趋势。
say.note: 会做时间序列分析并给出对比结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs Python via uv (always with numpy, never pandas, using DuckDB/Polars/pyarrow), picks the right tool per operation, queries files directly, aggregates/filters/sorts/joins, reports time and row counts, and plots with matplotlib when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like 'analyze the data', or mentions of CSV/Parquet files, group/filter/join operations, time trends, correlation, or SQL/DataFrame queries. Not for plain text/configs or tiny math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV and sum sales by category.
say_en.note: DuckDB will query the file and return a summary.

say_en.text: Filter this parquet by amount > 100, then sort by date.
say_en.note: Polars will handle it with lazy evaluation.

say_en.text: Compare yesterday and today and show the trend.
